description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the NationalityService within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It contains unit tests for methods that manage nationality data, such as retrieving lists, fetching by ID, deleting, and fetching by name.

classes.name: NationalityServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the behavior of the NationalityService in various scenarios, including listing, fetching by ID or name, and deletion of nationalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of NationalityService, and populates test data from a fixture file.

methods.name: testGetNationalityList
methods.description: Tests that the service correctly retrieves a list of nationalities based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetNationalityById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a nationality entity by its ID.

methods.name: testDeleteNationalities
methods.description: Tests deletion of a list of nationalities and verifies the number of deletions performed.

methods.name: testGetNationalityByName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a nationality entity by its name.
